prediction + used > soft limit at start

ledger_rules.legacy_or_foreign_rows: run refused (LedgerFormatError), nothing written or reinterpreted

time_operation.approval_status: PROPOSED - NOT APPROVED by the research lead
time_operation.audit_file: watchdog_audit.jsonl (hash-chained, append-only, in the run directory)
time_operation.extra_time: requires a new signed authorization record (cumulative_time_budget_s + supersedes_approval_ids) issued by the research lead; the run directory stays bound to the superseded lineage
time_operation.on_budget_reached: whole process group stopped (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after grace), STOP_REQUESTED/STOP_DONE/LAUNCH_END recorded, extension_request_data.json/.md written (completed/remaining/ETA/storage); no condition or convergence change
time_operation.on_abnormal_supervisor_end: children die with the supervisor (PR_SET_PDEATHSIG); open session counted conservatively at next start (STALE_SESSION_DETECTED); progress monitor raises ALERT
time_operation.driver_gate: run driver --execute only as a direct child of an open supervised launch of the same set
limits: a process that deliberately escapes the process group (setsid) is not contained
host suspend/clock jumps are not modelled (monotonic clock)
someone holding key and files can still bypass; this is not an access-control system
